cs.t: Das keyboard is right, but that's for my next upgrade. I bought a Razer Tarantula when I was still into video games. I outgrew (not really) the games but the keyboard still holds. The keys, halfway in between a full keyboard and notebook keyboard, are laid out perfectly. Even though I do say the Das Keyboard, I've been with the Tarantula enough to recommend it as well. I code now, all I ever do with it.
